title: Lifting affine objects of the closed site
statement:
For $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, write
$u:\mathcal B_X\to\mathcal B_Z$ for base change. For
$V=\operatorname{Spec}\overline C$ in the basis of
[def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis], set
$$
 v(V)=\operatorname{Spec}H_A(\overline C),
$$
using [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift]. Maps are the opposites of the maps
supplied by that algebra construction.
The constructions take values in the indicated bases by
[lem-exc-closed-lift-filtered] and [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability].

proof.text: For the coordinate algebra of V use the composite A -> Gamma(Spec A) -> Gamma(V). A morphism f : V -> W satisfies f.left composed with W.hom equals V.hom. Apply global sections to this triangle after composition with Spec(A/I) -> Spec A, and precompose with GammaSpecIso.inv. Evaluation at a in A gives closedSiteCoordinates_commutes and hence the contravariant A-algebra map.

The existing Algebra.ClosedLift.indEtale instance uses the filtered category Algebra.ClosedLift.Index and its displayed colimit presentation by etale algebras. Apply RingHom.IndEtale.algebraMap_iff and proAffineEtale_Spec_iff to obtain closedSiteLift_mem. No separate use of the general varying-base filtered-colimit stability theorem is necessary. Base change uses the existing proAffineEtale pullback functor.

The closed-lift algebra map commutes with the structural maps from A, by AlgHom.commutes. Applying contravariant Spec proves that its opposite is a morphism over Spec A. For identities and composition, compare the induced algebra maps after precomposition with each colimit structure map using colimit.hom_ext and Algebra.ClosedLift.iota_map (Lean name: Algebra.ClosedLift.ι_map). Postcomposition of index objects with the identity leaves each object unchanged; successive postcomposition with phi and psi is postcomposition with psi composed with phi. These identities are definitional for the explicit presentation model. Thus the closed-lift algebra maps preserve identities and composition. Coordinate maps reverse composition and Spec reverses it once more, giving the two functor laws. Assemble the object and morphism constructors into closedSiteLift.
